title: GOOSE Configuration
description: Pick the network interfaces to listen on, save, then start. GOOSE is published to the whole segment, so every control block on that link appears; there is nothing to connect to. Optionally add the substation's SCL file (.scd/.cid) to name dataset members. Live capture needs a one-time grant on the machine running the agent; run the Check permissions action first. Decoding a pcap file needs no privileges at all.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.description: Segments to subscribe to, in parallel. They share the one 'GOOSE' trace source and appear side by side under it, one branch per interface. Leave empty when using Replay PCAP File.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Network interface on the station bus (eth0, en0, enp3s0, ...). Choose from the machine running the agent, or type a name. The interface is put in promiscuous mode: GOOSE is multicast, and without it the NIC would drop every frame.

name.title: Name
name.description: Names this interface's branch in the signal tree. Defaults to the interface name. Letters, digits, space, '_' and '-' only. Every entry shares the one 'GOOSE' source, so each name must be unique.

scl.title: SCL File
scl.description: SCD or CID file describing the publishers on this segment. With it, each control block's dataset members are named from the SCL (ldInst/lnName.doName.daName) and typed from it. Without it, members are named d00, d01, ... and typed from the wire.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every interface, and replaying a capture file instead.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source for per-frame rows, '<prefix>/<interface>/goose'. Clear it to give each interface its own trace source. Decoded control blocks are global to the station bus and always appear under 'GOOSE/<goID>', whatever the prefix.

replay_pcap.title: Replay PCAP File
replay_pcap.description: Decode a .pcap/.pcapng file, optionally gzip or zstd compressed, instead of capturing live. This path opens no capture handle and needs no privileges, so it works on any machine; use it to analyze a capture someone sent you. Plays at the capture's original pace with timestamps shifted to start now. When set, the Interfaces list is ignored and the extension exits once the replay finishes. To try the extension without hardware, pick the bundled demo capture: the 'Demo Capture Path' action shows where it is.

replay_scl.title: Replay SCL File
replay_scl.description: SCL for the publishers in the replayed capture; same role as the per-interface SCL File.
